summary_en: 353,700 ordinary shares to be cancelled (5.9% of shares outstanding), effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 6,014,142; treasury shares: 180,739.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-13, Aval Data Corporation's board of directors resolved to cancel 353,700 ordinary shares (5.9% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) under Article 178 of the Companies Act. Cancellation is scheduled for 2026-08-31. The company stated that the cancellation aims to eliminate future shareholder dilution concerns and improve the free-float ratio. Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 6,014,142 and treasury shares will be 180,739 (as of 2026-07-31). The company holds treasury shares to support flexible capital strategy execution.
